title: Episode 4: Thirteen Minutes: The Lone Clockmaker Who Almost Killed Hitler
description: On November 8, 1939, a quiet German carpenter named Georg Elser detonated a precision clockwork bomb inside the Munich Bürgerbräukeller beer hall. Working in total secrecy for thirty consecutive nights, Elser designed a mechanical masterpiece that brought down the hall's stone pillar. Hitler missed the lethal blast by exactly thirteen minutes due to unexpected autumn fog.
